actions: OPEN INPUT CONTROL-FILE CARD-IN OUTPUT ONLINE-OUT REPORT-OUT
MOVE 'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `CARD-IN` for input and `ONLINE-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'CARDLOAD: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `CARD-IN` for input and `ONLINE-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `CARD-IN` for input and `ONLINE-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-BUSINESS-DATE` to `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`; and performs `1200-READ-CARD`.
When reading `CARD-IN` finds no more records, it reads `CARD-IN` and sets `WS-MASTER-END-SW` to `MASTER-AT-END`.
When reading `CARD-IN` finds a record, it reads `CARD-IN` and adds 1 to `WS-READ-COUNT`.
When `CR-EXPIRY-MONTH` is less than `WS-BUSINESS-MONTH`, it adds 1 to `WS-EXPIRED-COUNT` and performs `1200-READ-CARD`.
When `CR-EXPIRY-MONTH` is at least `WS-BUSINESS-MONTH` and `CR-STATUS` is `'B'` (`CR-BLOCKED`), it adds 1 to `WS-BLOCKED-COUNT`, performs `2100-WRITE-ONLINE`, and performs `1200-READ-CARD`.
When `CR-EXPIRY-MONTH` is at least `WS-BUSINESS-MONTH` and `CR-STATUS` is not `'B'` (not `CR-BLOCKED`), it performs `2100-WRITE-ONLINE` and performs `1200-READ-CARD`.

conditions: WRITE ONLINE-CARD FROM CARD-RECORD INVALID KEY
actions: MOVE 'MASTER NOT IN CARD NUMBER ORDER' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When writing `ONLINE-CARD` fails on its key, it writes `ONLINE-CARD` from `CARD-RECORD`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'MASTER NOT IN CARD NUMBER ORDER'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.
When writing `ONLINE-CARD` succeeds by its key, it writes `ONLINE-CARD` from `CARD-RECORD` and adds 1 to `WS-LOADED-COUNT`.
